# Hybrid Media

> Using a mix of Marketing and Public Relations to grow your Business

Hybrid Media is a communications agency that delivers strategic communications, digital storytelling, and creative campaigns through integrated marketing and public relations. Founded by communications strategist Sarah I. Bamford.

## Business
- Legal name: Hybrid Media LLC
- Website: https://hybridmediaonline.com/
- Category: Communications agency (marketing + public relations)

## Social
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hybridmediacomm
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/hybridmediacomm
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/HybridMediaComm
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@hybridmedia4360

## Services
- Marketing — Strategic campaigns that connect brands with the right audience
- Public Relations — Relationship-building and reputation management across media
- Hybrid Media Plan — Event direction, web development, branding, advertising, and editorial
